company_name: Zhenjiang Runjing High Purity Chemical Technology CO,.LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Zhenjiang Runjing High Purity Chemical Technology CO., LTD. specializes in manufacturing electronic chemicals critical for semiconductor processes.
summary: Zhenjiang Runjing High Purity Chemical Technology CO., LTD. is a leading manufacturer of electronic chemicals, particularly known for its production of tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH) and other wet electronic chemicals. The company serves major panel manufacturers and semiconductor clients, providing high-purity materials essential for various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Production of tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH) with a capacity of 60,000 tons/year
Manufacturing of high-purity solvents such as IPA and NMP
Development of etching solutions for copper, silver, aluminum, and silicon
Provision of cleaning solutions and strippers for semiconductor processes
technical_expertise: Wet chemical processing for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: The company is located in the International Chemical Industry Park in Zhenjiang New Area, Jiangsu Province, and has established a subsidiary in Hefei to enhance its manufacturing capabilities.
